newsitem.title: FRANCE: Danone invests in Turkish mineral water.
newsitem.headline: Danone invests in Turkish mineral water.

text.p: French food group Danone said on Wednesday that it had teamed up with Turkish group Sabanci to create a 50-50 joint venture through the Hayat company, which produces the Hayat Su brand bottled water in Turkey.
Hayat is Turkey's leading producer of still bottled water with a market share of 30 percent. It had 1996 sales of nearly 100 million francs from production of around 100 million litres.
Danone said in a statement that it will bring its expertise and beverage technology to the venture. Danone produces the Evian brand bottled water in France.
Demand for bottled water is rising steeply in Turkey, but per capita annual consumption is still only 13.6 litres compared with 110 litres in France.
